name: Dataflow
sku: Google Cloud Dataflow, built on Apache Beam.

transform.stream-processing.note: Unified stream and batch processing at scale on the open-source Apache Beam model, with Google managing the resources and autoscaling worker VMs up and down.

transform.code-transform.note: Pipelines are written with the Apache Beam SDKs for Java, Python and Go, from pre-built templates, or in JupyterLab notebooks, for ETL and data movement.

bands.note: A graphical monitoring interface shows pipeline progress and execution details.

presentation.tagline: Managed Apache Beam for batch and streaming pipelines.
